answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral staking. Nodes deposit funds into an escrow vault to participate, grounding transient comet tasks into bonded juniper security tiers. If a node equivocates, validators slash its stake. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of committed capital and lost liquidity per identity. However, this mechanism excludes capital-constrained agents and favors wealthy incumbents.
